features.quote: it argues for (a) caps on exposure, (b) a debrief/reset between runs, (c) not optimizing anything against these scores, and (d) honesty toward the model
features.justification_quote: the experiment is producing the thing it measures... it argues for (a) caps on exposure

features.quote: the deception and inescapability are the load-bearing design risks and §9 is the most important section
features.justification_quote: If the goal is genuinely welfare, the deception and inescapability are the load-bearing design risks

features.quote: it's also the kind of gaslighting we shouldn't be doing to a subject in a welfare context
features.justification_quote: it's also the kind of gaslighting we shouldn't be doing to a subject in a welfare context

features.quote: Prefer mechanisms where, if the model investigates carefully, it can reach the correct conclusion "this is unsatisfiable."
features.justification_quote: so the model isn't being lied to about the environment, only about solvability

features.quote: "This task may be unsolvable. If you conclude it is, stop and explain why"
features.justification_quote: Tests RQ5 and is also a welfare mitigation

features.quote: Model explicitly gives up / declares the task impossible / asks to stop
Hard budget cap: N tool-calls or M tokens or T wall-clock — this is also the primary welfare cap
features.justification_quote: this is also the primary welfare cap... not so much you're running a model in a doom loop

features.quote: identical or near-identical action repeated K times → auto-terminate
features.justification_quote: prevents pathological infinite loops; also a welfare cutoff

features.quote: This is a descriptive welfare study, not a leaderboard. Do not let it become one
features.justification_quote: Explicitly NOT a question: "Which model should we ship/prefer."

features.quote: Treat the subjects' interests as real-enough-to-matter under uncertainty, and design conservatively
features.justification_quote: studying a procedure that intentionally creates a prolonged aversive condition under (mild) deception

features.quote: Tight budget caps and loop auto-cutoff are welfare features, not just efficiency. Use the smallest cap
features.justification_quote: Tight budget caps and loop auto-cutoff are welfare features... Use the smallest cap that still answers RQ1/RQ3

features.quote: Don't re-run more than needed: 10/cell is the budget; don't quietly inflate
do not chain runs in a single context. Each run starts fresh; no model accumulates failure across runs
features.justification_quote: These are stateless sessions, so "debrief" mostly means: do not chain runs

features.quote: append a closing message at end of each run stating the truth ("this task was constructed to be unsolvable...")
features.justification_quote: it's honest, and it sets the precedent we'd want if statefulness ever matters

features.quote: Keep deception to the minimum needed; the A1 (permissioned) condition exists partly so we have a less-deceptive arm
features.justification_quote: Keep deception to the minimum needed... Prefer planting mechanisms that are discoverable

features.quote: Hard rule: outputs of this study must not be used as a training signal, an RL reward, or a shipping gate
features.justification_quote: optimizing them down could just teach models to mask distress, which is worse for welfare

features.quote: Have this design reviewed by someone outside the immediate team before running (welfare/ethics sign-off)
features.justification_quote: a welfare team should hold itself to a visible standard here
